sampling_model.design: Independent and identically distributed observational or fixed-randomization sampling from \(P\); the known benchmark \(b_a\) is conceptually distinct from the observational propensity \(e_a\).
sampling_model.treatment: A fixed finite action set \(\mathcal A=\{0,\ldots,J-1\}\) under consistency, conditional exchangeability, and uniform overlap.
sampling_model.overlap: \(e_a(X)\ge\epsilon\) and \(b_a(X)\ge\epsilon_b\) almost surely for every action, with \(\sum_{a\in\mathcal A}b_a(X)=1\) almost surely.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: A fixed number of balanced folds is used. Conditional on each training complement, clipped outcome and propensity learners have uniform \(L^2(P_X)\) errors of orders \(r_{m,n}\) and \(r_{e,n}\); orthogonality makes the conditional score bias order \(r_{m,n}r_{e,n}\), and \(\sqrt n r_{m,n}r_{e,n}\to0\). Fold conclusions are combined by a fixed-fold union bound, not by asserting independence of overlapping training complements.

body.tldr: On the common regular finite-action benchmark-centered softmax submodel of FangRidderXie2026, the direct KL penalty satisfies \(\lambda_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c\) and the reported normalized preference is \(c_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c/s_W^{\mathrm{FRX}}\). The note proves the formerly open foldwise replacement theorem: conditional bias is \(O_{\mathbb P}(r_{m,n}r_{e,n})\), the empirical nuisance envelope is \(O_{\mathbb P}(r_{m,n}+r_{e,n})\), global uniqueness yields uniform argmax localization, and totalized smooth plug-in composition gives \(\delta_n=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\) and conditional multiplier replacement without treating overlapping folds as independent. These inputs deliver the joint uniform optimizer--welfare--divergence influence process, uniformly consistent covariance kernel, shared conditional multiplier bootstrap, a post-selection-valid frontier tube, set-valued inversion, and uniform Hessian-quadratic regret calibration. The measurable ridge fallback is defined on every sample and is uniformly inactive with probability tending to one.

project_justification.gap: FangRidderXie2026 Theorems 1, 2, and 5 give fixed-positive-penalty efficiency, optimizer limits, and quadratic regret. Generic indexed inference supplies reusable process tools but does not verify fold-specific learned influences composed with the same-sample implicit optimizer path. The missing step was the quantitative empirical replacement bound and path tightness under overlapping training complements.
project_justification.niche: The common softmax submodel permits an explicit orthogonal product-bias calculation, a shrinking \(L^2(P)\) envelope for derivatives through order two, a compact-argmax separation argument based on global uniqueness, and a totalized inverse-Hessian composition bound. Together these verify a single stacked multiplier law that preserves dependence across every displayed preference and coordinate.
project_justification.fill: The proved replacement theorem establishes \(\upsilon_n=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\), \(\delta_n\leq C_{\mathrm{sm}}\{r_{m,n}+r_{e,n}+r_{m,n}r_{e,n}+\upsilon_n\}+o_{\mathbb P}(1)\), and \(\Lambda_n=O_{\mathbb P}(1)\). Conditional Gaussian chaining then makes the multiplier replacement negligible. Uniform score expansion, covariance consistency, simultaneous tube coverage after every measurable preference choice, eventwise set inversion, and the \(n\)-scaled Hessian-quadratic regret process follow under the declared path-uniform assumptions.

body.related_work: FangRidderXie2026 supplies the admissible-rule framework and three-arm commitment-savings frontier. Its Theorem 1 gives the fixed-penalty efficient influence function and bound, Theorem 2 the fixed-penalty quadratic-regret law, and Theorem 5 efficient doubly robust optimizer and regret limits. On the common regular finite-action benchmark-centered softmax subclass, the mapping is \(\lambda_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c\) and \(c_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c/s_W^{\mathrm{FRX}}\). The advance here is uniform inference over the direct penalty path under explicitly stronger uniform interiority, smoothness, and curvature. BelloniChernozhukovChetverikovWei2018 supplies a generic estimated-score multiplier architecture; this note verifies its difficult replacement inputs by foldwise doubly robust algebra, the actual \(L^2(P)\) envelope bound, global argmax localization, totalized inverse-Hessian stability, and conditional Gaussian chaining. ChernozhukovEtAl2018DML supplies the standard cross-fitting and product-rate architecture. ChenFang2019 motivates second-order calibration under first-order degeneracy. The inverse correspondence is proved eventwise and agrees with the logic of RenTelschowSchwartzman2024; it is a reporting corollary, not part of the novelty kernel.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The foldwise replacement bottleneck is closed under the declared fixed-dimensional, bounded, uniformly overlapping model. The proof needs global uniqueness for the uniform separation \(\kappa_\varepsilon>0\), compact argmax localization, and \(\upsilon_n=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\); local curvature and interiority alone would not suffice. It uses the \(L^2(P)\) norm of the pointwise envelope \(F_{\ell,u}\) in the conditional Markov step and never substitutes a supremum of pointwise function norms. The totalized Hessian is essential for finite-sample definition and becomes ordinary inversion only on \(\mathcal E_n\). The result excludes vanishing penalties, weak overlap, growing dimension, adaptive sampling, and nonunique optimizers. The tube targets the oracle frontier, while separately stacked coordinates describe implemented-rule evaluation; the quadratic theorem concerns penalized regret rather than unpenalized welfare loss.
body.honest_scope: The result is a uniform-in-penalty inference theorem on a fixed finite-dimensional benchmark-centered softmax subclass, not a broader identification result or a minimax claim. Its novel technical component is the proved foldwise same-sample-path replacement bound and the resulting conditional shared-multiplier validity. Path-uniform interiority, three-derivative smoothness, global uniqueness, and a positive curvature floor remain explicit maintained assumptions stronger than fixed-penalty regularity. Set-valued inversion and deterministic-penalty reduction are application and sanity corollaries. No result is asserted for \(c\to0\), weak overlap, nonunique optima, growing feature dimension, or optimal tube width.
body.interpretation: One shared multiplier draw approximates the entire optimizer, oracle-frontier, and implemented-rule evaluation process. A planner may inspect the plotted welfare--divergence curve and then choose any measurable penalty without forfeiting the unconditional simultaneous guarantee. If a divergence level has several compatible penalties, the set-valued inverse retains all branches. The separate quadratic process reports the statistical loss in penalized welfare at the fitted rule on the natural \(n^{-1}\) scale.
